title: SpaceX 已向 SEC 递交保密 IPO 申请，承销商名单曝光
summary: 知情人士透露，SpaceX 于 4 月 1 日正式提交保密 IPO 申请，高盛与摩根士丹利担任联席主承销商，目标估值区间 $3500 亿–$4000 亿美元，S-1 最快 5 月初公开。

title: Binance, Polymarket seek Polygon hard fork to recover $6.8M in stolen crypto
summary: Polygon block producers have already frozen the stolen tokens, but a proposed hard fork would allow the funds to be recovered and returned to their owners.

title: Trump-linked tokens lead crypto losses after Democrats sweep in the US midterms

title: Canton Coin Gets SEC Nod as Wall Street Tokenization Heats Up
summary: SEC staff said they view Canton Coin as a digital commodity and won’t recommend enforcement over how it’s minted, a week after DTCC launched a tokenization service that runs partly on the Canton Network.

title: Circle’s ARC token sale lifts earnings as lower yields weigh on USDC income
summary: Circle is looking to payments fees and future staking rewards to diversify revenue as its core stablecoin business faces pressure from lower yields and growing competition.

title: Wall Street’s Plumbing Goes Onchain as Morgan Stanley Tokenizes Securities
summary: Morgan Stanley says it has converted U.S. equities and Treasuries into tokenized form through the newly launched DTCC Tokenization Service, which 20 Wall Street firms have signed up to use.
